## Why visit

A characterful small cask stop in a former post office, complete with the old postbox outside and displays of local history. This gives a Crosby/Waterloo excursion a second independent beer destination alongside The Coop. Cask variety and the real-cider badge are the reasons to choose it, while the room is especially suitable for a relaxed conversation.

## Beer

Four changing cask ales from smaller breweries, with Colbier and Rock the Boat among the reported guest producers. Recent CAMRA sightings include Hawkshead Iti, Reedley Hallows Filly Close Blonde and Ossett Jet, in addition to the reported Colbier and Rock the Boat guest producers.
